# Lodestone Warps 1.0.1-26.3

Bug-fix release for Minecraft Java Edition 26.3.

## Fixed

- Restored drag-and-drop controls after the Minecraft 26.3 mouse button API change.
- Restored dragging the main panel, resizing it, moving the horizontal scrollbar, and reordering columns in settings.

## Notes

- Compatible with Minecraft Java Edition 26.3.
- Java 25 or newer is required.
- Fabric API remains a required dependency.
